claims.claim: in six 0.4-ha ponds adult (black bass) numbers did not predict October age-0 numbers (Allen et al. 2011)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The abstract (USGS record) agrees: largemouth bass, six 0.4-ha hatchery ponds stocked with 6–40 adults over 2 years, drained in October; 'no relationship between stock abundance and recruitment', recruit abundance highly variable within and among density groups, prey abundance and age-0 growth fell with age-0 density. If the rewrite keeps it on the abstract, say '(abstract)' and name the species (largemouth bass).
